name: Raíces Podridas
source:
Raíces Podridas is a Visual Novel that mixes comedy elements with terror, where you play as Esteban, a man who, along with his wife, embarks on a trip to visit his sister-in-law, Jimena, who recently lost her husband because of a car accident.
Spanish only.
translation:
《Raíces Podridas》是一部融合喜剧与恐怖元素的视觉小说。你将扮演埃斯特班，与妻子一同踏上旅程，探望妻子的姐妹希梅娜。她的丈夫不久前在一场车祸中丧生。
仅支持西班牙语。
